text: {"assertions":["A latency spike in ml/serving/batcher.py was caused by an off-by-one error in a slice bound.","The latency spike manifested only on the first request after a cold start.","The issue was reproduced by sending a mixed-size request trace.","The latency spike's signal was a tail far above the median in the serving histogram.","The fix corrected the slice bound and added a property test (PR #3155 on branch fix/latency-spike-1).","A flaky test in the batcher code improved from 4 failures per hundred runs to zero failures after the fix.","This latency spike work occurred in the same area of ml/serving/batcher.py as earlier latency spike fixes.","The fix was completed on 2026-03-10 in the ml pipeline serving code."]}
